bug_semantics: An authenticated backend user holding backend.manage_editor can store attacker-controlled LESS in Editor Settings -> Markup Styles (html_custom_styles). A payload such as .x { content: ~"</style><script>alert(1)</script><style>"; } makes Less_Parser preserve literal closing-style/script markup. In vulnerable releases the compiled string is emitted unescaped inside the backend-wide <style> block, so the injected script executes for later backend-page visitors. The compiled raw value is also cached, making this a stored XSS path.
flaw_origin: Commit c9dab67bc819b791df8432a898dd976f19388a87 reintroduced the flaw by changing modules/backend/layouts/_custom_styles.php from <?= strip_tags(EditorSetting::renderCss()) ?> to <?= EditorSetting::renderCss() ?> while ostensibly improving exception-message escaping. EditorSetting::renderCss() still returned and cached raw Less_Parser output. The immediate parent retained the output sanitizer, so this sanitizer deletion—not the 2016 feature creation, later view rename, or a release aggregate—is the smallest true BIC for the advisory's affected line.
ai_marker: Absent on the BIC commit object. `git cat-file commit c9dab67bc819b791df8432a898dd976f19388a87` shows author and committer `Luke Towers <git@luketowers.ca>`, one parent, and only the message `Improve escaping of error messages when compiling custom CSS for Brand & Editor settings`; it contains no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI trailer, or bot identity.
evidence: The assigned GitHub advisory snapshot identifies backend.manage_editor, html custom styles compiled by LESS and rendered on every backend page, the official range >=1.2.10,<1.2.13, claimed first patch 1.2.13, and referenced fix d28f0b9474af79cfaa80eeb9d691f7a7c4469720. In the clone, `git log -L 10,13:modules/backend/layouts/_custom_styles.php c9dab67bc819b791df8432a898dd976f19388a87` reconstructs the sink lifecycle: ef290df3af545b2e0ca28fc1773dc0399b555f72 first emitted EditorSetting::renderCss(), a9a2c6e83b2d2455c62640075f5833ae953b7b02 added strip_tags(), and c9dab67bc819b791df8432a898dd976f19388a87 removed it. `git log --all --reverse -S'strip_tags(EditorSetting::renderCss())' -- modules/backend/layouts/_custom_styles.php modules/backend/layouts/_custom_styles.htm` independently identifies a9a2c6e83b2d2455c62640075f5833ae953b7b02 and c9dab67bc819b791df8432a898dd976f19388a87. `git show 22df8f1d6d8e95487e385bd4f052d0c772a2b3fc:modules/backend/layouts/_custom_styles.php` shows the parent calling strip_tags(EditorSetting::renderCss()), and `git grep -n 'EditorSetting::renderCss' 22df8f1d6d8e95487e385bd4f052d0c772a2b3fc -- modules/backend` finds only that guarded call, directly proving parent absence. `git show --format=fuller --patch c9dab67bc819b791df8432a898dd976f19388a87` shows the one-line sanitizer deletion and `git cat-file commit` gives parent 22df8f1d6d8e95487e385bd4f052d0c772a2b3fc plus the marker-free human commit object. `git tag --contains c9dab67bc819b791df8432a898dd976f19388a87 --sort=version:refname` starts at v1.2.10 (v1.2.9 tag 5d029a1972825698cacbbe400dea2541f2d889a2 is not listed), matching the introduction boundary. `git show d28f0b9474af79cfaa80eeb9d691f7a7c4469720` adds return strip_tags($customCss), and `git tag --contains d28f0b9474af79cfaa80eeb9d691f7a7c4469720` starts at v1.2.13. However, `git blame -L 244,262 v1.2.13 -- modules/backend/models/EditorSetting.php` proves v1.2.13 still returned raw Cache::get($cacheKey) before reaching that sanitizer, so a cache miss stored raw malicious CSS and the next cache hit remained exploitable. The actual closing commit c95d780ab54f3a3f74a94ae1667bf12b3c549d5d changes the cache-hit path to return strip_tags(Cache::get($cacheKey)) and adds cache-hit/pre-existing-cache regression tests; `git blame -L 244,262 v1.2.14 -- modules/backend/models/EditorSetting.php` attributes that line to c95d780ab54f3a3f74a94ae1667bf12b3c549d5d, and `git tag --contains c95d780ab54f3a3f74a94ae1667bf12b3c549d5d --sort=version:refname` starts at v1.2.14. Thus d28f0b9474af79cfaa80eeb9d691f7a7c4469720 is the advisory-named partial fix, while c95d780ab54f3a3f74a94ae1667bf12b3c549d5d is the direct complete fix and the true full-fix release boundary is v1.2.14.
reasoning: The original raw rendering feature dates to ef290df3af545b2e0ca28fc1773dc0399b555f72, but a9a2c6e83b2d2455c62640075f5833ae953b7b02 subsequently installed the exact strip_tags guard, so attributing the 2026 affected range to the 2016 commit would ignore direct parent state. c9dab67bc819b791df8432a898dd976f19388a87 is the minimal causal reintroduction: it alone removes the only sanitizer from the sole backend render call, and its parent is demonstrably safe. It is a normal single-parent commit, not a squash or move. The advisory's d28f0b9474af79cfaa80eeb9d691f7a7c4469720 fixes only the cache-miss return; c95d780ab54f3a3f74a94ae1667bf12b3c549d5d closes the surviving cache-hit path, so both are recorded with their distinct roles. AI judgment is restricted to the c9dab67bc819b791df8432a898dd976f19388a87 commit object, whose human identity and message have no AI signal; therefore the verdict is NOT_AI.
